title: Assessing Large Language Models for Stabilizing Numerical Expressions in Scientific Software
abstract: arXiv:2604.04854v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scientific software relies on high-precision computation, yet finite floating-point representations introduce precision errors that propagate in safety-critical domains. Despite growing use of large language models (LLMs) in scientific applications, their reliability in handling floating-point numerical stability has not been systematically evaluated. This paper evaluates LLMs' reasoning through two tasks: (1) detecting instability in numerical expressions by generating error-inducing inputs (detection), and (2) rewriting expressions to improve numerical stability (stabilization). Building on popular numerical benchmarks, we assess 4 state-of-the-art LLMs on 2,037numerical structures, including nested conditionals, high-precision literals, and multi-variable arithmetic, across 469,000 tasks. translated_title: 评估大型语言模型在科学软件中稳定数值表达式的表现
translated_abstract: 科学软件依赖于高精度计算，然而有限的浮点数表示会引入精度误差，这些误差在安全关键的领域会不断传播。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在科学应用中的使用日益增多，但它们在处理浮点数数值稳定性方面的可靠性尚未得到系统评估。本文通过两个任务评估LLMs的推理能力：（1）通过生成引发错误的输入来检测数值表达式中的不稳定性（检测），以及（2）重写表达式以提高数值稳定性（稳定化）。基于流行的数值基准，我们在2037个数值结构上评估了4个最先进的LLMs，包括嵌套条件、高精度字面量和多变量算术，共涉及469,000个任务。我们的结果表明，LLMs在检测和稳定化数值不稳定计算方面补充了传统方法。值得注意的是，LLMs在这些任务中表现优于传统方法。
tldr: 本文首次系统评估了大型语言模型在科学软件中检测和稳定化数值表达式的能力，发现它们能有效补充甚至超越传统方法。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates large language models' ability to detect and stabilize numerical expressions in scientific software, finding they complement and even outperform traditional approaches.
